name: CADCraft
summary: Open and edit DXF and DWG drawings in Nextcloud with CADCraft
description:
Open a DXF or DWG drawing in Files with **Edit in CADCraft** and work on it right in the browser, the way you know from AutoCAD: the command line, object snaps, layers, dimensions, hatches, blocks and layouts.

- **Save** (QSAVE) writes the drawing straight back to Nextcloud in its own format, and Nextcloud keeps the previous state as a file version.
- Exports and plots (PDF, PNG, SVG) and saves under another name store a file in any folder you pick.
- Read-only files open normally; saving offers a copy.
- If someone else changes the file while you have it open, you choose whether to replace their version or save a copy.
- Optionally, clicking a DXF or DWG file in Files opens it in CADCraft.
readme_features:
- **Edit in CADCraft** appears in the Files action menu of every DXF and DWG drawing you can read.
- **Save** (QSAVE, Ctrl/⌘+S) writes the drawing back to Nextcloud in the format it was opened in, and Nextcloud keeps the previous state as a file version.
- Exports and plots (PDF, PNG, SVG), and saves under another name, ask for a name and folder in your Nextcloud the first time.
readme_limitations: - DWG support follows CADCraft's own (see its file-format notes); if a DWG doesn't round-trip, save it as DXF.
bridge_notes: With `?host=parent`, CADCraft starts on the Start tab rather than an empty Drawing1, the files it saves go to the parent instead of the browser's downloads (the engine's delivery hook), and the parent guards leaving the page with unsaved changes.
